correctness.rationale: Verified the exact substitution s=sign(cx0), z=s y, w=|c x| to z_next=z+w, w_next=w(1+a/(1+z^2)). Because w≥w0, z≥z0+n w0, the increments are summable and w increases to W>0; ∑_{k≥n} a w_k/(1+z_k²)=a/(W n)+O(log n/n²). Summing w−W establishes the logarithmic z correction with finite renormalized constant. At the first crossing z_N≥z0+1, the pre-crossing multipliers ≥r=1+a/(1+R²) and ∑_{k<N}w_k≤w_N/(r−1) force W≥r−1 independent of x0. Nonfixed points escape every compact set, hence Poincare recurrence yields the stated classification of invariant probabilities. Tested signed coordinate identities and velocity bound for five numerical orbits, including x0=10^−12; source script read, not executed.
